example.title: Seattle Ship Supply warehouse, Fishermen's Terminal
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: A 1970s marine-supply warehouse: a big two-storey gabled shed of white and pale grey corrugated metal with a row of upper windows, a lettered sign band across the gable front, a covered loading dock and pickups parked in front. Three photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
